_doc: PLAN 9.7 playtest 2026-05-04 — hand-curated SuperChargers vehicle terrain. Keys are lowercase base vehicle names; the indexer matches by substring (longest-first) so variant prefixes like 'Dark', 'Legendary', 'Power Blue', 'Nitro', 'Springtime', 'Eggcited' all resolve to the base vehicle's terrain. Values: 'Land' | 'Sky' | 'Sea'. Source: Chris's playtest list 2026-05-04 (matches Skylanders SuperChargers canon).
